A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same LiveXiv research work, with 33 complete pages including Appendices A.1–A.6. Text, equations, tables, figures, and appendix material can be reliably matched.

before.justification: v3.pdf reports original LMM evaluations on LiveXiv, manual-verification experiments, and empirical tests of efficient evaluation in Section 4 and Appendices A.2–A.5.

after.justification: v4.pdf retains these original empirical results, including benchmark accuracies, manual-verification comparisons, and performance-prediction experiments on LiveXiv and MM-LiveBench.

M1.justification: Sections 3.1–3.3 retain the same question-generation and filtering pipeline, Rasch/IRT estimator, and model-selection procedure. The appendix prompt templates and generation variants are also unchanged.

E1.justification: Both PDFs cover the same LiveXiv VQA/TQA tasks, dataset releases, scientific domains, historical-paper scenario, and MM-LiveBench evaluation. The newer LiveXiv dataset versions already appear in v3.pdf.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged across corresponding experiments: 17 initial LMMs, the retained Pixtral and Molmo additions in subsequent dataset releases, and 13 LMMs for MM-LiveBench.

E3.justification: The multiple-choice accuracy protocol, sample counts, manual-verification design, and efficient-evaluation budgets of 3, 5, 8, or 12 models remain unchanged in Section 4 and the appendices.

E4.justification: Both retain the same manual-verification studies, generator/filter role swaps, domain and question-category analyses, difficulty distributions, temporal-shift tests, and multi-generator IRT analyses in Appendices A.2–A.5.

E5.justification: The MAE and mean-absolute-deviation reporting in Figures 4–5 and Appendix A.5 is unchanged. No repeated-run, seed, confidence-interval, or significance-testing information is added or revised.

E6.justification: Numerical entries, plotted results, rankings, and reported findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 1 retains Claude-Sonnet's 75.4% VQA and 83.5% TQA mean accuracies; Table 2 retains absolute average differences of 2.336 and 2.105.

T1.justification: The Rasch probability model in Equation 1, expected-performance estimator in Equation 2, Fisher-information criterion, and associated assumptions are unchanged. No mathematical definition, derivation, or proof is added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: automated live multimodal benchmarking, reduced contamination risk, and efficient evaluation through re-evaluating a small model subset.

C2.justification: Interpretations of model rankings, potential Claude filtering bias, generator-induced distribution shifts, and the limitation of relying on proprietary models remain unchanged in Section 4, Section 5, and Appendix A.5.

D1.justification: Implementation descriptions, evaluation details, Appendix A.6 prompt templates, and the HuggingFace dataset and GitHub code links are unchanged. No technical or reproducibility information is newly disclosed.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning in Section 2 and Appendix A.1 are unchanged. Removing a duplicate comma from the Mirza et al. reference changes punctuation only.

P1.justification: v4 updates the arXiv version/date stamp, removes a duplicate bibliography comma, and replaces 'Figure ??' with 'Figure 13' in Appendix A.4.3. The remaining prose and document structure are unchanged.

P2.justification: The first-page arXiv margin stamp moves downward and slightly right. All 21 figures and 18 tables retain their content, captions, design, and placement; the scientific page layout is otherwise unchanged.

improvement.justification: The differences are confined to version metadata, margin-stamp placement, bibliography punctuation, and one resolved figure pointer. These small editorial changes leave the methods, empirical evidence, interpretations, limitations, and reproducibility information unchanged, producing no meaningful overall quality difference.
